payload.summary: Mobile LCP breaches every measured route; Therapy catalogue remains one contributor
payload.detail: Outcome: mobile LCP breaches budget across every measured route, not just Therapy. Latest live three-sample medians on 2026-08-13 were root 5711 ms, Therapy 5077 ms, Services 4887 ms, Forms 4620 ms, DSM 4547 ms, and Documents search 4015 ms; 89-96% of LCP was render delay. Therapy remains a catalogue-specific contributor, but it is no longer the sole outlier. The current performance branch removes the Therapy workspace graph from the exact home and non-Therapy routes; this still needs deployed exact-SHA proof. Next: deploy the scoped fixes, rerun the live three-sample workflow, prioritize shared-shell/root render delay, then retain the existing per-field safety review for Therapy search/pathways. Gate: focused tests, production build, complete CI Lighthouse and live three-sample evidence. Stop: do not strip clinical fields or close this row from local/incomplete Lighthouse.
payload.source: session 2026-08-13 live latency review and performance-fixes branch
